text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Sungai Besi) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 April 2014.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Sungai Besi yang

bermula dari—

(a) kilometer 0.0 laluan utama di Persimpangan Bertingkat UPM

di koordinat U332136.086, T414399.924 Grid Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir

di kilometer 5.9 laluan utama di koordinat U337094.354,

T412330.268 Grid RSO (GDM 2000) termasuklah Persimpangan

Bertingkat Balakong, Persimpangan Bertingkat Seri Kembangan,

Plaza Tol Mines (Selatan) dan Persimpangan Kelab Lumba Kuda,

iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 5.9 kilometer;

(b) kilometer 21.2 laluan utama di koordinat U346806.626,

T415590.054 Grid RSO (GDM 2000) dan berakhir

di kilometer 21.9 laluan utama di koordinat U347116.310,

T416241.808 Grid RSO (GDM 2000) termasuklah Tanjakan Jalan

Pandan 1, iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 0.7 kilometer; dan

(c) kilometer 1.2 Hubungan Pandan di koordinat U346290.969,

T415821.825 Grid RSO (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 3.3

Hubungan Pandan di koordinat U346757.162, T417890.631 Grid

RSO (GDM 2000) termasuklah Tanjakan Jalan Indah dan Tanjakan

Jalan Pandan Makmur, iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 2.1 kilometer,

diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

 DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SUNGAI BESI HIGHWAY) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor, makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Sungai Besi Highway)

Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 April 2014.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Sungai Besi Highway commencing

from—

(a) kilometre 0.0 main line at the UPM Interchange at coordinates

N332136.086, E414399.924 Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO)

Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 5.9 main line

at coordinates N337094.354, E412330.268 of the RSO (GDM 2000)

Grid including Balakong Interchange, Seri Kembangan Interchange,

Mines (South) Toll Plaza and Turf Club Intersection, being a

distance of 5.9 kilometre;

(b) kilometre 21.2 main line at coordinates N346806.626,

E415590.054 of the RSO (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre

21.9 main line at coordinates N347116.310, E416241.808 of the

RSO (GDM 2000) Grid including Jalan Pandan 1 Ramps, being a

distance of 0.7 kilometre; and

(c) kilometre 1.2 Pandan Link at coordinates N346290.969,

E415821.825 of the RSO (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre

3.3 Pandan Link at coordinates N346757.162, E417890.631 of the

RSO (GDM 2000) Grid including Jalan Indah Ramps and Jalan

Pandan Makmur Ramps, being a distance of 2.1 kilometre,

is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
